description: A Java class named TestConfig that provides centralized configuration for a test automation project. It loads environment variables, system properties, and defaults to determine configuration parameters like base URL, browser type, headless mode, Chrome binary path, and credentials.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve configuration values for test automation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value, prioritizing system properties, then environment variables, then defaults.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for testing.

methods.name: browser
methods.description: Returns the browser type to be used in tests.

methods.name: headless
methods.description: Indicates whether tests should run in headless mode.

methods.name: chromeBinary
methods.description: Returns the path to the Chrome/Chromium binary, if specified.

methods.name: adminUsername
methods.description: Returns the admin username for login.

methods.name: adminPassword
methods.description: Returns the admin password for login.
